title: A report builder
description:
Build a text report of any length with a string buffer, then write it to a file.

```
Sales report, 2026-11-20
========================
tea       12   30.00
coffee     5   30.00
...
total: 7 products, 214.50
written to report.txt (412 bytes)
```
hints: Write the whole report into the buffer first, then one `fwrite(sb.data, 1, sb.len, f)` (lesson 8.01).
The date line comes from `strftime` on `gmtime(&now)` (lesson 8.03).
requirements: A `StrBuf` with `sb_append` and `sb_appendf` as in lesson 8.01; no fixed-size text buffers for the report.
Columns lined up with `%-8s` and `%7.2f` style formats.
Every allocation checked; the report freed at the end.
stretch: Add a `--csv` option that writes the same data as CSV instead.
